title: The Social Regulation of Threat-related Vigilance and Arousal
official: Effects of Trauma and Discrimination on the Social Regulation of Threat-related Vigilance and Arousal
summary: This study will examine the effects of social support on threat vigilance and arousal using eye tracking. We will also test the moderating effects of trauma and discrimination history.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* In a stable romantic relationship for 6 months or more
* Normal vision or corrected-to-normal vision
* Fluent in English

Exclusion Criteria:

* If vision is corrected-to-normal, needs to use hard contact lenses, bifocal contact lenses, or glasses
* Experienced a traumatic event within the past 4 weeks
